numerical_errors: The relator-lift approach is incomplete: kernel_gens only contains lifts of codomain relators, but omits domain relators which also map to identity
Generator order relations are not computed: for each generator g where φ(g) has finite order n, g^n should be in the kernel but is never added
When codomain is FreeGroup (relators=[]), kernel_gens remains empty regardless of the actual kernel structure
missing_cases: Domain relators (G.relators) are not included in kernel generators - they always map to identity and belong in the kernel
Generator image orders: if φ(g) has order n in codomain, then g^n is in kernel but this is never computed
Fallback path when use_relator_lift=False due to ValueError does not properly continue to permutation group conversion - it just breaks out of the loop
No validation that kernel_gens is non-empty before returning FpSubgroup for non-trivial kernels
actionable_fixes: Add domain relators to kernel_gens: insert 'kernel_gens.extend(G.relators)' before the relator loop
Add generator order relations: for each generator g in G.generators, compute order of self(g) and append g^order to kernel_gens if finite
Fix the ValueError handling: when use_relator_lift becomes False, the code should fall through to the permutation group conversion path, not just break
For FreeGroup codomain, compute kernel from generator images directly since there are no relators to lift
Ensure the return statement after the relator loop only executes when kernel_gens is properly populated or when the kernel is genuinely trivial
